art_direction.title: Rain over the old town

text:
Rain over the old town
Rain all afternoon, fog in the low streets. I said farewell to the old bookshop that closes this week — the owner gave me a stamp to remember it by. Nostalgia, quiet and grey.
Some days are just for closing doors.
title: Rain over the old town
